name: Oliver James Harrington
title: Principal DevOps Engineer
summary: Principal DevOps Engineer with 12+ years of experience designing resilient cloud platforms, automating delivery pipelines, and improving operational maturity across regulated environments. Known for leading cross-functional teams, reducing release friction, and driving measurable gains in reliability, security, and engineering productivity.

bullets: Led a platform modernisation programme across 18 product teams, reducing deployment lead time from 2 days to under 30 minutes.
Built Python automation services for environment provisioning and operational tasks, cutting manual support tickets by 41%.
Implemented Terraform-based infrastructure standards and reusable modules, improving consistency across 120+ cloud resources and lowering configuration drift.
Introduced SLOs and observability dashboards that reduced MTTR by 34% and improved on-call response times.
Designed and maintained AWS landing zones and secure CI/CD pipelines for regulated workloads, supporting PCI and ISO-aligned delivery practices.
Migrated 60+ services to Kubernetes, increasing release frequency from monthly to weekly while improving service uptime to 99.95%.
Used Python and Bash to automate release validation and compliance checks, saving an estimated 20 hours per week for engineering teams.
Partnered with security and platform teams to implement secrets management and policy-as-code controls, reducing audit findings by 50%.
Established the first automated build and deployment pipelines for a portfolio of internal applications, reducing deployment failures by 63%.
Provisioned environments using Infrastructure as Code and standardised Linux server builds, shortening new environment setup from 3 days to 2 hours.
Created Python scripts for log analysis and deployment reporting, improving incident investigation speed and visibility for stakeholders.
Supported Windows and Linux server estates across 40+ retail sites, maintaining availability for business-critical services.
Helped implement early monitoring and patching automation, reducing recurring incidents by 27% over 12 months.
Collaborated with developers to improve release procedures and basic scripting automation, laying the foundation for later DevOps adoption.
